answer: Like yarrow that only grows where its roots truly touch soil, require each identity to periodically prove presence at a distinct physical place: a signed, timestamped check-in from a geofenced location, cross-checked against nearby peers. A dune of fake accounts collapses because one operator cannot be in many places at once, and karst-style hidden links surface when two identities claim the same spot simultaneously. Cost to an attacker: one person or device physically present at each claimed location, kept up over time, per fake identity.
